tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Search live Belgian or Luxembourg legal jobs on LexGO. Compact results without descriptions. Call get_job before recommending. Give the candidate click_url. Do not apply on their behalf.

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Full sanitized description and structured facets. Call this before recommending a vacancy. Fetch by integer id, id-slug, url, or click_url from search_jobs. Give the candidate click_url.

tools.name: list_functions
tools.description: List LexGO job function names (lawyer, in-house counsel, paralegal, notary, …) for use as function_id filters. Names only; no SEO HTML. Prefer list_taxonomies for the full vocabulary.

tools.name: list_taxonomies
tools.description: List function, discipline, region, and work-environment ids plus experience, contract, and work-arrangement enums. search_jobs accepts function_id, discipline_id, work_environment_id, region_id, experience_id, contract, and remote (boolean). work_arrangement ids are labels, not filters. Names only;

tools.name: list_events
tools.description: List upcoming scheduled legal trainings and events on LexGO. On-demand webinars are excluded.

tools.name: get_event
tools.description: Fetch one upcoming LexGO event by integer id, id-slug, url, or click_url. Give the candidate click_url.
